headline: Nomura issues buy ratings for 17 Indian consumer stocks
hook: Nomura identifies 17 consumer sector growth bets
summary: Nomura has released a list of 17 consumer-facing companies with 'Buy' ratings, citing strong demand resilience. The brokerage projects an average EBITDA growth of 13.8% year-over-year for these firms despite ongoing margin pressure from rising inventory costs. This outlook suggests significant upside potential for the selected stocks. Retail investors can use these projections to assess their current exposure to the consumer discretionary and staples sectors.
why_it_matters: Brokerage outlooks may influence short-term price action in consumer stocks.
winners_losers: Consumer sector stocks gain / No clear losers
